benefits.title: King’s can substantiate its graduate premium with greater confidence and specificity
benefits.statement: King’s has a richer, evidence-backed account of the value its students gain, with claims grounded in course-level evidence, institutional data and wider evidence of skills, experience and graduate futures.
benefits.beneficiary: King’s, faculties, departments and disciplinary communities
benefits.realisationPeriod: From 2026/27, deepening across the mobilisation period
benefits.successLooksLike: Graduate premium claims and narratives are specific, evidence-linked, appropriately caveated and capable of being traced back to credible institutional, course-level or qualitative evidence.

benefits.title: The graduate premium can be represented with disciplinary depth and compelling human evidence
benefits.statement: Faculties, departments and disciplinary areas are represented through a coherent mix of facts, narratives, proof points and high-quality human and visual evidence rather than generic institutional language alone.
benefits.beneficiary: Faculties, departments and teams that need credible graduate premium content
benefits.owner: Faculty and central marketing expertise with Daniel Robson
benefits.realisationPeriod: From Year 1 exemplars, with broader coverage by 2028/29
benefits.successLooksLike: Priority areas have publication-ready graduate premium asset packages that combine robust evidence with distinctive narratives, case material and rich media, and can be handed to 2.4.4 or other legitimate users without requiring the core proposition to be rebuilt each time.
